hints.title: Game State Space Formulation
hints.text: Represent state as (turn, mouse_r, mouse_c, cat_r, cat_c) where turn indicates whether mouse or cat is moving next.

hints.title: Terminal Base Conditions
hints.text: Mouse wins immediately upon reaching food. Cat wins immediately upon catching mouse or reaching food before mouse. Cat wins if turns exceed 128.

hints.title: Retrograde Analysis via Queue BFS
hints.text: Initialize terminal states in a queue and propagate victories backwards: winning predecessor state wins; all losing predecessor moves force a loss.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: State space bounded by turn count T and positions of cat and mouse.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded recursion enters infinite loops because moves can be undone and cycles exist.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Turn bounding guarantees finite state graph termination.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Minimax game state formulation with cycle prevention and turn bounding.
